jobs.occupation: Experienced Firmware Engineer - low level embedded SW
jobs.description:
Join us in building the foundation of next generation hearing device platforms.

_Are you passionate about firmware close to the metal? Do you enjoy understanding how hardware really works and applying your expertise to build stable, efficient real time embedded systems? Would you like your work to make a real difference for millions of people living with hearing loss worldwide?

If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

About The Team

You will join our Foundation Firmware area within the R&D Device SW organization — a group of about 25 highly skilled engineers working in three scrum teams. Together we build and maintain the low level firmware that forms the foundation of all Demant hearing device software platforms.

We work closely with hardware, software and production teams throughout every stage of platform development. The atmosphere in the team is informal, friendly, and highly engaged. We believe the best results come from a fruitful team effort. We support each other, provide constructive feedback, and share knowledge and ideas to continuously improve our solutions and reach common goals.

What You Will Be Working On

Our work spans the full development flow of a resource-constrained platform — from IC specification and early bring-up, through development, verification, and production, all the way to product release. This means working in simulations, on FPGA prototypes, and on real silicon as our platforms mature. Our chipsets are internally developed, multi-core network-on-chip solutions designed for ultra-low-power audio. Our firmware platform includes hardware drivers and HAL, RTOS integration, power management, file handling, communication stacks, security, firmware update functionality and more.

You will design, develop, test, and release firmware for our custom ICs, working closely with other embedded software, hardware, production, and verification teams. Your focus will be on delivering advanced functionality with real-time guarantees for the system, while always balancing memory consumption, compute cycles, and power efficiency to meet the high standards of medical devices. This means writing safe, efficient C code that enables our hearing devices to perform reliably in highly resource-constrained environments. You will use and help improve specialized in-house tools that assist the development process, as well as automated regression tests that safeguard stability and performance of our platform as it evolves.

In summary, your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Design, develop and test efficient firmware for our chipset platform

• 
Support hardware and production teams in bring up, calibration and verification

• 
Contribute to the definition and development of our internally developed ICs

• 
Implement safe and efficient C code for real time applications

• 
Help ensure high quality through automated tests and CI/CD

• 
Participate in team ceremonies and knowledge sharing

What You Bring

You hold a degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or similar, and you have a solid hands-on experience – at least 3 years – within the following areas of embedded SW development:

• 
Embedded C programming for memory , power and time constrained systems

• 
Understanding of processor architectures and MCUs

• 
Real time operating systems (RTOS) and real-time handling of HW

• 
Reading HW schematics

• 
Working with measurement instruments such as logic analyzers or oscilloscopes

• 
Automated unit and system testing

• 
Version control systems (git)

• 
Linux, scripting and custom toolchains

You take pride in building high-quality, maintainable code and are comfortable working in large, shared code repositories with comprehensive testing and a complex build flow. You can work independently, but you also enjoy collaborating within the team and across teams to achieve the best results.

Why Demant?

At Demant, we believe in balancing professional passion with a fulfilling personal life. Our flexible hybrid work model allows you to work from home up to two days per week. Each morning, you can enjoy complimentary breakfast, and lunch is provided daily in our canteen. To support your well-being, you will have access to fitness facilities, weekly training sessions, and massage services. If you are parent, we offer attractive parental benefits, including the option to stay home when your young child is unwell. Above all, we prioritize a respectful and inclusive workplace culture where colleagues support one another, and everyone feels valued.

How To Apply

This is a full time position located at our headquarters in Smørum, Greater Copenhagen area. (Please note: We are not considering part time, consultant, or internship contracts for this role.)

Please submit your CV and a short motivation via our online portal no later than October 30th, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis. If you have questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Maja Lončar, Senior Manager System Firmware, at mjln@demant.com.

We expect to conduct first-round interviews in weeks 44-45 and second-round interviews in weeks 45-46.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

_

**Role Description

**We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain & Operations professional (Director rank and upwards) to drive business development, delivery excellence, people leadership and strategic positioning. The candidate will act as the commercial, professional and cultural leader within the Supply Chain domain and will work closely with fellow Partners in the leadership team to strengthen Unify Partner's overall market position.

The ideal candidate is able to bridge industry and consulting, drive business development initiatives and diversify our client portfolio, lead complex transformation projects and provide people-oriented leadership across both external projects and internal initiatives.

**Success in this role is measured across three primary domains:

****Business Development

**

• Expand and commercialise Unify Partner's position within the Supply Chain advisory area through clear subject matter expertise and strong client relationships.

• Win and lead large transformation programmes spanning the intersection of Supply Chain Excellence, ERP and Data/AI.

**Strategy

**

• Ensure the unification and development of Supply Chain & Operations and ERP as a core service offering area

• Contribute to building new growth areas for Unify Partners, particularly within AI & Supply Chain

**People & Leadership

**

• Strengthen and maintain engagement, professional development and retention among consultants within the SC&O service offering area.

• Ensure cohesion across the Supply Chain offering and Unify Partner's other service offerings

• Provide employees with clear professional and cultural leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Commercial Development

**

• Develop strategic relationships at CxO level and translate expertise into business for Unify Partners

• Develop proposals and commercial offerings within the intersection of Supply Chain & ERP

• Contribute to building a strong sales and consulting culture at Unify Partners.

Leadership & People Development

**Qualifications, We Hope You Will Bring

**

• 
Engineering degree (i.e. DTU) or MSc in Supply Chain Management (CBS)

• 
Strong combination of industry experience and external consulting experience. Candidates are expected to have more than 8 years experience.

• 
Proven advanced consulting toolkit, demonstrated through consistent origination of work, trusted CxO relationships, sponsorship of complex deliveries, development of senior consultants, and contribution to firm‑level growth and culture.

• 
Experience from industrial or manufacturing environments (potentially MedTech).

• 
Fluent in Danish and English.

**Subject Matter Expertise

**

• 
Supply Chain expertise as the primary area of subject matter expertise including:

• 
Supply chain strategies

• 
Supply chain planning

• 
Warehouse management

• 
Network optimisation

• 
ERP as a secondary area of expertise

• 
Experience with ERP rollouts, particularly in the context of Supply Chain processes

• 
Understanding of the interplay between production and warehouse operations.

• 
Experience with in- and outsourcing.

**Technical Skills

**

• Solid data understanding and confidence working with large data sets

• Knowledge of PowerBI and general data visualisation tools

• Hands-on understanding of ERP systems and comfortable working directly in the systems

• Strong working knowledge of the Supply Chain module in either Microsoft Dynamics 365 or SAP.

**Leadership Experience

**

• Relationally strong and able to build a sense of team cohesion and invest time in colleagues personal and professional development

• Thrives at the intersection of deep expertise and business development.

**What We Offer

**

• A vibrant and growing company where your voice matters. You’ll have real influence over how we work, collaborate, and evolve.

• A company that believes that rest is productive. Our working policies are built on trust, autonomy, and psychological safety with flexibility being a keyword.

• A clear path forward, regardless of your rank. We support your growth through project leadership, client impact, and contributions to thought leadership – internally and externally.

• A close-knit team of passionate people who move fast, support each other, and value initiative. From Friday breakfasts to champagne rituals for new joiners and strategy tours abroad, we celebrate and foster belonging.

• We offer a fair and transparent salary model, regularly benchmarked against market standards. Your package includes private health insurance, flexible pension contribution and optional perks like discounted gym memberships and monthly office massages.

In just a short time, we’ve built a strong foundation for growth, now counting 36 passionate colleagues and we’re just getting started.

We believe that the best results come from bringing diverse minds together. That’s why our culture is built around collaboration and inclusion. We call it “the power of together” - combining expertise across disciplines and working closely with our customers and partners to deliver meaningful impact.

Our values are simple but powerful: we strike a balance between delivering high-impact client work and prioritising wellbeing. We grow through knowledge sharing, mentoring and hands-on experience and we all contribute towards building a workplace where belonging and social connections thrive. If you would like to see more about our culture, check out our instagram and LinkedIn @UnifyPartners

If you’re ready to join an ambitious, fast-paced and forward-thinking team – apply today, we’d love to meet you.

_At Trackunit, we collect data from machines and job sites across the globe, and we are building the products that make that data useful. As a Data Engineer in our Data Products team, you will design and operate the pipelines and datasets that sit behind our analytics and future machine learning products. You will work closely with data science and alongside experienced engineers in our Data Foundation team. It is hands-on work with real ownership, in a small team where what you build actually ships.

**What’s in it for you?

Take ownership in a small team. Shape the data engineering work in our Data Products team, with a direct influence on how we build reliable, reusable products for customers.

Build the data behind new insights. Develop pipelines and datasets that support benchmarking, analytics, and future machine learning products as we move from individual customer solutions to products serving many customers.

Work with varied, challenging data. Combine equipment and sensor data with external sources, including satellite and weather data, and make it ready for analysis and modelling.

Work closely with data science. Partner with our data scientist on customer needs, solution design, and data preparation, with opportunities to grow into feature engineering, model deployment, and MLOps.

Learn through collaboration. Work alongside experienced engineers in our Data Foundation team, supported by an international culture of knowledge sharing, feedback, and professional development.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• You have experience designing, building, and operating production data pipelines, with strong SQL, Python, and data modelling skills.

• Databricks expertise is a significant advantage. You ideally bring strong hands-on experience building and operating pipelines with Spark and Delta Lake, managing data quality, and preparing datasets for analytics and machine learning.

• You treat data quality as part of the product. You build automated validation, monitoring, and alerting, and can investigate problems from a customer-facing result back to the source.

• You have worked with cloud data platforms and tools for orchestrating and transforming data, and can make practical choices about reliability, performance, and cost.

• You understand how to keep pipelines maintainable as data sources change, using testing, CI/CD, clear documentation, and thoughtful handling of schemas and dependencies.

• You have worked alongside data scientists, or bring a strong understanding of their needs, including preparing reliable datasets for exploration, feature engineering, and model training.

• You enjoy contributing to requirements and solution design, translating customer needs into practical data solutions, and taking ownership while collaborating across teams.

• Experience integrating external APIs and feeds, working with geospatial or time series data, or processing large datasets efficiently would be a plus. Interest in model deployment and MLOps is welcome. You don’t need to tick every box. If data engineering is your core strength and you’re curious about data science and the products it enables, we’d like to hear from you.

**Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

**Responsibly 🌍🌱

**Responsibly is a VC-backed sustainability tech start-up with a vision of making every purchase in the world responsible. We're founded by serial entrepreneurs with previous successes like Ofload, Dixa and Neurons, funded by some of Europe's top VCs and angels, and now cash-flow positive with an incredibly exciting roadmap ahead.

**Let's change the world together 🎯

**More than 40% of global emissions, and really any ESG issue, are directly or indirectly impacted by procurement. Companies wield enormous purchasing power when they select and manage suppliers, so if we can put sustainability on every supplier scorecard out there, we really can change the world.

But it's hard: a company can have anywhere from 100 to 100,000 suppliers, analyzing each one's sustainability efforts is near-impossible, and most ESG ratings suck. Responsibly's AI-powered due diligence engine automates the due diligence on every supplier across every ESG data point, from risk and violations to positive actions, and turns it into insights that help companies build more sustainable supply chains.

**The engineering problem 🧩

**Most of what we do comes down to one hard thing: turning the world's messy, unstructured supplier data into something you can score.

A supplier's ESG reality is scattered across PDF sustainability reports, half-broken corporate websites, regulatory filings, news, and a dozen ERP exports that all name the same company differently. We scrape it, extract it, resolve the entities, normalise it, and put a number on it, at a scale where a single customer can have 100,000 suppliers.

That means real problems, not ticket-shaped ones. Extraction pipelines where the LLM is confidently wrong 5% of the time and you have to decide what to do about it. Entity resolution where "Nordic Steel A/S" and "NORDIC STEEL" and "Nordisk Stål" may or may not be the same company. Schema design for data that arrives in a different shape every time. If that sounds fun rather than exhausting, we should talk.

**Build next-gen products with next-gen technologies 🌟

**You'll work on a Next.js app leveraging the latest in server actions, server components and serverless architecture, building dynamic, high-performance applications with TypeScript, PostgreSQL and AI integrations.

We don't just leverage AI in our product; we're building a next-generation engineering team where you're not only encouraged but expected to adopt the latest technologies in how you work. Our engineers run agentic coding tools daily, and we'd rather talk about where they fall down than whether to use them.

**How We Work 🛠️

**

• The engineering team is small and you're reporting directly to Christian, our CTO. There is no layer between you and the decisions

• Specs are limited. You'll get a problem, what the output should look like, sometimes vaguely, and you're expected to own it from there to release; including where to ask for more information. If you'd rather have the approach agreed before you start, you will find this uncomfortable

• You choose how to solve it, and you ship it. Idea to production is days, not quarters. We run weekly sprints - considering going bi-weekly - most often with releases as the goal for the sprint. You own what you write across its whole lifecycle, including when it breaks

• There is little process versus a bigger organization, and what we're planning to adopt is mainly for the ai agents to support you

• You will sometimes be wrong, ship it, and fix it. That's okay

• We're in the office at Islands Brygge 3-5 days a week, on the water. We prefer meeting face-to-face to stay in sync and move fast, with some support for remote working

**What You'll Be Doing 🙌

**

• Take operational ownership of the code you write across the entire software development lifecycle

• Work on production code, from customer-facing features to bug fixing

• Design new features and see them through to completion

• Help build and evolve our services and infrastructure to stay ahead of our growth curve

• Turn conceptual ideas into production-ready, scalable features

• Be a big part of finding the best solutions to our daily challenges

**Requirements

**Where you lack a line on this list but can convince us you'll close the gap fast, apply anyway. We mean that literally: one of the best engineers we've had joined us as a junior and was senior within two and a half years.

**Three things we do need:

**

• A proven track record - or evidence of extraordinary ability. We care far more about what you've actually built than how many years you've been doing it. Senior engineers should have a track record of shipping and maintaining serious production software. But if you're earlier in your career and you've built something remarkable, we want to hear about it. We're looking for exceptional people, not arbitrary numbers on a CV

• Strong TypeScript, and the judgement that comes from shipping real software. You know the language deeply, but more importantly, you know what good production code looks like. You can make architectural tradeoffs, keep a codebase healthy as it grows, and tell the difference between an interesting technical problem and one that actually matters

• Strong database fundamentals, and an AI-native mindset. You understand PostgreSQL and relational data deeply — schema design, query performance, indexes, migrations, monitoring, and what happens when your database meets millions of messy real-world records. And AI isn't something you're interested in. It's already part of how you work. You use machines to build machines. You automate aggressively. You constantly look for ways to make yourself and the team 10× more effective. This is non-negotiable for us

**Nice to have, genuinely not required:

**

• Next.js specifically (Server Components, Server Actions, API routes). If you know modern React, you'll be fine within a fortnight

• Web scraping at genuinely awkward scale

• Working with large-scale data: data pipelines, analytics, transformations, or making sense of millions of messy records

• General ESG, procurement or supply-chain domain knowledge

**Benefits

****Practical stuff 📋

**

• Salary: band between 50-60k / month for a senior engineer

• ESOP: every full-time Responsibly'er owns a piece of the company. We'll show you the actual numbers, strike price, vesting, and what your slice could be worth at a few exit scenarios, before you have to decide anything

• Location: Copenhagen. You'll need to be here or firmly planning to move, and to have the right to work in Denmark. English is our working language

• Office: Islands Brygge, right on the water. Great lunch, great coffee, obligatory ping-pong table. Roughly three days a week together, flexible on which and on hours

**Also 🤩

**

• Enthusiastic, highly talented teammates from all backgrounds, always ready to share knowledge, support, and a beer

• Strong personal and professional development in a high-growth environment

• Annual company events and Friday bars

• Real impact. Life is about more than work

_Turn financial insight into measurable business impact

_Do you know how to turn financial data into clear commercial decisions — and want to see your insight make a real difference? Join Group Finance at the heart of an ambitious international business. As Group Business Controller, with primary focus on the UK, you will help strengthen performance, sharpen decision-making and build reporting that scales with the business.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark, with limited travel to the UK as required.

**The opportunity

**Based at our Group office in Copenhagen and reporting to the Group Finance Manager, you will combine Group-wide contribution with hands-on ownership of the UK business. As the link between Group Finance, UK Operations and store teams, you will create consistency in reporting, strengthen performance management and translate data into actionable business insight. You will also help modernise how we work with data by advancing report automation, dashboards and the practical use of AI — delivering faster, more reliable insight.

jobs.description:
Combine weather modelling, machine learning and Python to turn complex data into actionable insights and production-ready solutions that support trading decisions across various power markets.

The job

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, you will work at the intersection of weather data modelling and fundamental forecasting, driving research and innovation within quantitative weather analysis.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• 
conducting research in AI- and data-driven weather modelling within a power trading context

• 
developing and improving fundamental forecasting solutions that translate weather signals into actionable power market insights

• 
performing ad hoc weather and market analyses to support trading, renewable asset balancing and commercial decision-making

• 
exploring new data sources, modelling approaches and analytical methods to strengthen our quantitative weather capabilities

• 
turning research and analysis into robust, scalable solutions that can be used directly by traders and algorithms

The team

Meet the team

You will join our Quantitative Weather Analysis team, where we develop weather-driven insights, forecasts and models that support trading decisions and renewable asset optimisation across our business.

We are a team of specialists with backgrounds in data science, physics and computational biophysics. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves, and aim to create an informal atmosphere and a team where people genuinely enjoy working together. We also value spending time with each other beyond the task at hand, whether that is grabbing a coffee, having lunch or simply catching up during the day. Together, we have built a culture where we help each other, share knowledge freely and feel comfortable asking questions or challenging ideas.

By combining multidimensional weather data, machine learning and market understanding, you’ll help shape trading decisions and optimise the balancing of our renewable asset portfolio.

Talia Zeppelin

Head of Quantitative Weather Analysis

Your qualifications

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be working deeply with quantitative modelling and large datasets, we imagine that you take a curious and proactive approach to your tasks. You enjoy digging into how things work with a research-to-action mindset and challenge existing approaches when you see room for improvement. We also expect that you are comfortable taking ownership of projects while collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• 
have an educational background in Economics, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science or a related quantitative field

• 
are experienced in writing production-quality, maintainable code in Python

• 
are comfortable working in Linux-based environments and using common command-line tools

• 
have a solid quantitative foundation and can work with statistical, mathematical or data-driven modelling

• 
can work with large, complex datasets and transform data-driven insights into practical solutions

• 
are curious about the power trading domain and has an execution and collaborative mindset

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

What To Expect At Dalux

At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

Ready for the next step?

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

About Dalux

Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

As soon as possible
